name: Evernorth Behavioral Health
one_liner: Therapy for adults, couples and families by video or in person, in network with Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth and Centivo plans.
best_for: Adults with a Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth or Centivo plan who want in-network therapy
Couples or families looking for therapy covered by those plans
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need psychiatry or medication management
People using an EAP benefit or another insurer's plan
short_description: Evernorth Behavioral Care Group is Cigna's own therapy practice, offering individual, couples and family therapy by video or in person.
long_description: Evernorth Behavioral Care Group is a therapy practice run by Evernorth, Cigna's health services business, launched in 2024. It offers individual, couples and family therapy for concerns such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, substance use, trauma and PTSD, mostly by video, with in-person appointments in some places. It says it has providers in all 50 states and Washington, D.C., and generally offers an appointment within 72 hours. It is in network with Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth Health Services and Centivo plans; it does not accept EAP benefits, does not treat anyone under 18 and does not offer psychiatry or medication. After you fill in an onboarding form, staff check your coverage and give an estimated price range; missed or late-cancelled sessions cost $100, which insurance does not cover. There are no published studies of this practice.

pricing.starting_price: Copay or coinsurance with a Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth or Centivo plan; no self-pay price published
pricing.notes: Staff check your coverage after onboarding and give an estimated price range; payment is taken at the end of each appointment. EAP plans are not accepted. Missed sessions or cancellations with less than 24 hours' notice cost $100, not reimbursed by insurance.

privacy.notes: Therapy records are covered by Cigna/Evernorth's HIPAA notice, but Evernorth's state privacy notice says it may 'sell' or 'share' identifiers and browsing data with ad networks; deletion rights are listed only for residents of certain states.

patient_summary: You fill in an onboarding form and are matched with a therapist, or ask a care navigator to help, and then meet by video or sometimes in person. It works with Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth and Centivo plans, and you pay your plan's cost share at each visit. It is for adults only and does not prescribe medication.

availability.note: Adults 18+ with a Cigna Healthcare, Evernorth or Centivo plan; virtual therapy in all 50 states and D.C., in person in some areas.
